terms.attestationFrequency: Not publicly disclosed (on-chain carbon credit verification)

about.description: TCO2 is Toucan’s project-specific tokenized carbon credit format. Each TCO2 corresponds to a specific carbon credit type with metadata such as project and vintage, enabling exposure to project-specific attributes. TCO2 tokens can be deposited into Toucan pools (such as BCT or NCT) to mint pooled reference tokens, or held directly.
